basic_info.description: This vacant 2-bedroom, 2-bath detached home offers comfort, value, and room to grow. The upper-level features 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, a bright living room, formal dining area, and kitchen with breakfast nook. Lower level includes 2 additional rooms and a bathroom, legalized under Daly City's Home Safe Program'' in 1994ideal for extended living, office, or hobby space with its separate entrance.  Enjoy a south-facing backyard with excellent sunlightperfect for your future garden. Located in one of Daly City's best weather pockets, close to schools, public transportation, and library/rec center. A solid, livable home with great potential for those looking to personalize and add value!
